overview: Medical, dental, and healthcare education in Ireland is globally recognized, accredited by the Medical Council of Ireland, Dental Council of Ireland, Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI), and CORU, offering world-class clinical training in major teaching hospitals across Dublin, Cork, and Galway.
fee: €45,000 - €60,000 per academic year for Medicine/Dentistry; €14,000 - €26,000 for Nursing & Allied Health Sciences
eligibility: 10+2 with PCB (minimum 80-85%) + IELTS (minimum 6.5 - 7.0 overall) + HPAT-Ireland / entrance interview where mandated.
